environment: API and Cloud 5.1.73 runtimes on loopback against disposable PostgreSQL 16.15 databases keledon_phdk_uat and keledon_phdk_cloud_uat; synthetic-only fixtures, no production/customer data.
method: For each service, authenticated HTTP GET count and DELETE endpoints were called with anonymous, existing tenant-admin, and superadmin identities. Each DB started with zero cleanup candidates. A unique eligible ended empty orphan plus active, metadata-bearing, Event-bearing, FlowRun-bearing, and SubAgent-bearing sessions were created. The superadmin count and delete calls were checked; remaining fixtures were verified and removed. Cloud UAT used one temporary synthetic superadmin row, deleted after the run.
cleanup: All synthetic session fixtures and the temporary Cloud superadmin were removed; candidate counts in both DBs returned to zero; API and Cloud runtimes stopped; disposable PostgreSQL stopped cleanly; listeners on ports 55438 and 3041-3043 absent.
